title: Seedance 2.5 generates entire scenes with your character locked in
description:
ByteDance released Seedance 2.5, an AI video model that generates a full thirty second multi shot scene with audio in the same pass, up to 4K. The reference system takes up to fifty assets so your product or character looks identical in every frame, which is what most AI ads get wrong.

The full walkthrough, the prompt structure that works, and how to keep credits under control: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Tp3flClk1tKWGjlEtG6FhuuZQ-ywUN3CppqYUvV1aMM/edit?usp=sharing
